metadata.description: Video-making skills for Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code: every frame and every note generated in code, one skill per visual style.

plugins.name: painted-animation
plugins.description: Hand-painted watercolour-and-ink cartoons and lyric videos: p5.js + p5.brush, rendered frame by frame in headless Chrome, with storyboarding, character acting, beat sync and karaoke.

plugins.name: kinetic-reel
plugins.description: Kinetic-typography motion reels: bold condensed type, HUD micro-type, three.js generative layers, shape-continuity transitions and a synthesized beat-locked score.

plugins.name: ai-media-generator
plugins.description: Prompt craft and browser automation for AI image, video and music generation: picks the right platform (Kling, Seedance, Veo, Suno, Midjourney, Runway and more) and writes platform-specific prompts. Vendored from Hao0321/ai-media-generator (MIT).
